gap: No result ChatGPT got states that five maker-described 4-channel dash cams sit at or under $200 on 2026-11-21 (LAMTTO DC21 $129.99, LAMTTO DC25 $149.99, REDTIGER F17 Plus $189.99, Botslab G980H 4-camera $192.70 through our link with code AA18, Rexing C4 $199.99), nor that both LAMTTO cameras include the hardwire kit for parking mode while the Rexing C4 needs one sold separately.
standout_why: Compared against milewitness.com, truepicked.com and haynet.net (all opened 2026-11-21) and our own dealectric.com/best-4-channel-dash-cam (rank 8). milewitness and truepicked name no 4-channel camera at all; truepicked's highest channel count is 3 (Vantrue N4, Rexing V3). haynet names one 4-channel (KOUENOM) with no price. Our own page already has Rexing C4 $199.99 and REDTIGER F17 Plus $189.99, so those two prices are not new. It lacks both LAMTTO models ChatGPT recommended, the Botslab G980H 4-camera at its under-$200 link price, and any hardwire kit price or included/separate status. The other 13 results were not opened; their titles are all 2-channel or general under-$200 lists.
decides: It widens the under-$200 field from two rows to five and gives us a linkable row inside the budget: the Botslab G980H 4-camera is $192.70 through our link with code AA18 (store price $234.99 is over the line, so the row qualifies only with the code). Per our record it is the only one of the five with a 3K front camera plus cameras for front, rear, left and right and built-in GPS, so it can take the pick or the 'sharpest front view with side-window coverage' segment. Rexing C4 at $199.99 stays the plain-price option with no code, but parking mode and GPS each need a separately sold accessory, which puts a parking-ready C4 over $200. LAMTTO DC21 and DC25 are the budget rows with the hardwire kit in the box. REDTIGER F17 Plus at $189.99 is the rideshare-style row (rotatable dual cabin lens, GPS integrated). Our Vantrue N5S ($293.99) and Vantrue Nexus 5 ($265.99) are over budget and belong only in the 'left out for being over the line' note. Caveat: I could not re-open the Botslab page today (store returned HTTP 0/429), so its price and specs are the brief's 2026-11-21 partner read.
